messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now. If you need the precise time, you can check a reliable world clock or your device’s time settings for New York City.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time. But we can use the weather_forecast_get function? That function returns weather forecast, not time. There's no function to get time. We can approximate by using the current UTC time and subtract offset. But we don't know current UTC. We could say we don't have real-time. The best answer: "I don't have real-time data." Or we can say "As of my last update, it's X." But we can't guarantee. So we should respond that we don't have real-time.
